recordId.description: The match, venue, referee or competition it's on.

kind.description: Servers from before files leave it out: everything they have is a photo.

name.description: A file's name (FILE-10), ending in what it really is (.pdf, .xlsx…), and the name it's downloaded with. Photos have none.

width.description: Its width in pixels, when the upload gave it.

position.description: Its place among the record's photos, or among its files, from 0. A referee's first photo is their picture.

url.description: Where to fetch the file: /v1/attachments/{id}/file, with the same sign-in or an API key that can read the record.

thumbUrl.description: A small version for lists and galleries: /v1/attachments/{id}/thumb (a photo itself when none was uploaded).

hasThumb.description: Whether thumbUrl gives an image: false for a file other than a photo that was added without a thumbnail, which shows its kind's icon instead (FILE-12). Servers from before files leave it out, as every attachment then has one.

description: A photo on a match, venue or referee (FILE-1), or a file on a match, venue or competition (FILE-6). They're private: fetching them needs the same sign-in as the rest of the API, or an API key that can read the record (FILE-14).
